name: Purépecha (Mexico)
description: Quartered purple (upper hoist), light blue (upper fly), yellow (lower hoist) and green (lower fly). At the centre a black obsidian stone bears a raised fist amid flames, over a bow and arrows and the motto 'Juchari Uinapekua' (Our Strength).
history: The Purépecha flag was created in 1980 in Santa Fe de la Laguna, Michoacán. The four colours stand for the four regions of the Purépecha land: purple for the Ciénaga de Zacapu, blue for the lake region, yellow for the Cañada de los Once Pueblos and green for the Meseta (highlands).

features.role: obsidian stone with raised fist, flames, bow and arrows and the motto 'Juchari Uinapekua'
